proposal.condition: The threats channel lists at least two enemies and the outgoing channel says the last 5 or more decisions in which I fired hit nothing.

focus.question: Which visible enemy has the greatest shown width in pixels?

proposal.why: At 70 health, five firing decisions had missed the 8-pixel-wide focus while a 15-pixel-wide enemy remained available; continued unsuccessful firing ended in death. Selecting the wider target earlier improves the chance of eliminating a threat before the action delay and incoming damage exhaust the remaining health.
